prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1102; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Nobody gave the claimant's name at the scene; the claimant joined the claim days later.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I found a two-vehicle collision. Driver 1 was turning left when the front of the vehicle was struck by Driver 2's vehicle. A Passenger was riding with Driver 1. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was checked at the scene. The reported symptoms fit the kind and force of this impact. Damage to both vehicles is mostly in line with the described sequence of events. Scene photographs confirm several of the reported positions and damage areas. A few old scratches on the rear panel of Driver 1's vehicle may be older than this collision. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1's name was not given to me at the scene, and the claim was reported several days later. Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle. Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the scene.
